id./param/scenario/cs/y_010_cs_010.pack|cs_: "Oh no, tchi! Oh no, tchi!

"The Tockles are in big trouble, tchi!
  We want someone's help, but
  no one can see us, tchi!

"I don't know what to do anymore, tchi!
  This is a real pinch, tchi!
"Huh? Can you really see me, tchi!?

"Wow, tchi! At last I've found
  someone who can see me, tchi!

"No fibbing, tchi!
  You can definitely see me, tchi!

"If you can see me, you must be the Hero,
  tchi! Yay! I finally found you, tchi!

"Nice to meet you, Hero!
  I'm Kurutchi of the Tockles, tchi!
  Sudden, but I have a favor to ask, tchi!

"Please save us Tockles
  from our pinch, tchi!
  I'm begging you, tchi!

"Huh? No way, tchi! The Hero
  wouldn't say that, tchi!
  I'll ask you again, tchi!

"Yay, tchi! I knew the Hero
  would say yes, tchi!

"Hey, {var:1}.
  Who have you been talking to
  this whole time?

"Now then, let me guide the Hero
  and friends to our village, tchi!

"What is this village...?
  It just appeared out of nowhere...
"Yikes, what is this thing!?

"You're the Hero's friend, tchi! I forgot
  to say, Tickington is filled with a
  mysterious power, tchi...

"Within the village, even ordinary people
  can see us Tockles, tchi!

"...Hm? Tickington? Tockles?
  Saying that out of nowhere,
  I've no idea what you mean.

"If you have something to say, explain it
  so I can understand.
"...Um, then I'll explain, tchi!

"Our Tickington has a different flow of
  time from Erdrea. It's in a totally
  different place, tchi!

"We Tockles, who watch over time's course,
  have lived here to fulfill a mission, tchi!

"Oh, I must tell the Elder about the Hero, tchi!
  So ask the Elder about the rest, tchi!

"The Elder is in the altar room
  up the village stairs, tchi!
  I'll go ahead, tchi!
